verse.verse_1: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
verse.verse_2: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
verse.verse_6: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
verse.verse_7: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
verse.verse_8: In that day other faces will be calm,
verse.verse_11: Where they hear no idle speech,
verse.verse_17: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
verse.verse_18: And the heaven, how it is raised?
verse.verse_19: And the hills, how they are set up?
verse.verse_20: And the earth, how it is spread?
verse.verse_21: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
verse.verse_22: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
verse.verse_23: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
verse.verse_24: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
verse.verse_25: Lo! unto Us is their return
